summary: Abzan toughness trebuchet: defender mana, self-mill, then fling or mutate the Trees.

tags.name: defenders
tags.reason: Walls, Trees, and Axebane/Battlement mana exist to count as high-toughness bodies and to transform Catapult Fodder.

tags.name: toughness
tags.reason: Combat, Catapult Captain, Tree exchanges, Betor, and Ikra all pay off toughness rather than power.

tags.name: life exchange
tags.reason: Tree of Perdition, Tree of Redemption, and Mister Negative are the named kill packages.

tags.name: mutate
tags.reason: Nethroi's mutate trigger is the graveyard dump that puts the trebuchet pieces into play.

tags.name: reanimator
tags.reason: Nethroi, Eerie Ultimatum, Reveillark, Six, and Shifting Woodland return the ammo from the yard.

tags.name: graveyard
tags.reason: The 99 mills itself so Nethroi and the Trees have targets.

tags.name: self-mill
tags.reason: Stickfingers, Ripples, Stitcher's Supplier, Underrealm Lich, and Lumra stock the yard on purpose.

tags.name: lifedrain
tags.reason: Vito, Enduring Tenacity, Wound Reflection, and Bloodletter turn life swings into table damage.

tags.name: lifegain
tags.reason: Nethroi lifelink, Ikra, Children of Korlis, and Tree of Redemption feed the drain engines.
